title: HAMP-LIC: Hessian-Aware Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Learned Image Compression
abstract: arXiv:2608.12239v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Use this plain-text version for the arXiv abstract field: Learned image compression (LIC) models achieve strong rate-distortion performance but are hindered by high computational complexity and encoding-decoding mismatches across heterogeneous hardware platforms. Uniform fixed-precision quantization alleviates these issues but suffers severe quality degradation at low bit widths because it ignores differences in the quantization sensitivities of individual layers. To enable efficient and accurate low-bit deployment of pretrained LIC models, we propose HAMP-LIC, a Hessian-aware mixed-precision post-training quantization (PTQ) framework with a four-stage optimization strategy. First, block-wise sensitivity is estimated from the Hessian trace to capture second-order importance. translated_title: HAMP-LIC：基于Hessian感知的混合精度训练后量化方法用于学习型图像压缩
translated_abstract: 学习型图像压缩（LIC）模型在率失真性能上表现出色，但受限于高计算复杂度和异构硬件平台上的编码-解码不匹配问题。统一固定精度量化能缓解这些问题，但在低比特宽度下会因忽略各层量化敏感性的差异而导致严重质量退化。为实现预训练LIC模型的高效且准确的低比特部署，我们提出HAMP-LIC，一种基于Hessian感知的混合精度训练后量化（PTQ）框架，采用四阶段优化策略。首先，通过Hessian迹估计块级敏感性，以捕捉二阶重要性。其次，一个任务感知的细化模块通过联合考虑量化失真和率失真性能来调整这些敏感性。第三，在此基础上……
tldr: 提出一种基于Hessian感知的混合精度训练后量化框架，通过四阶段优化策略实现学习型图像压缩模型的高效低比特部署，兼顾精度与性能。
en_tdlr: Propose a Hessian-aware mixed-precision post-training quantization framework with a four-stage optimization strategy for efficient and accurate low-bit deployment of learned image compression models.
